name: Dumbbell Tate Press
steps: Lie on a bench with feet planted and both dumbbells above your chest, inner ends touching and palms facing your feet.
Keep your upper arms angled slightly outward and stationary as you bend your elbows wide to the sides.
Lower the inner heads of the dumbbells slowly down toward your chest until they lightly touch or hover just above it.
Press the dumbbells back up along the same arc by contracting your triceps until your elbows return to full extension.
tips: Avoid bouncing the dumbbells off your chest at the bottom of each repetition.
Keep your shoulders pinned to the bench and move strictly at the elbows.
